Maps of the Regnskapsregisteret filing shape

Source: R/regnskap.R
regnskap_maps.Rd

The bundled datasets regnskap_dict, regnskap_groups and regnskap_items describe the filing JSON (OpenAPI 1.1.16) the way field_dict, role_groups and role_types describe entities and roles: regnskap_dict is applied by rename_from_dict() and coerce_types() and names the line items, regnskap_groups names the objects that group line items (its level-0 rows are the three statements, regnskap_statements()), and regnskap_items carries the English and Norwegian labels brreg_label() applies. regnskap_identities lists the accounting identities checked per filing on the line items (by item name; optional terms count as 0 when absent) within regnskap_tolerance. All of this is published under brreg_regnskap in inst/extdata/endpoints.json and held equal to these objects by tests/testthat/test-endpoints.R.
